newsitem.title: CHINA: China gymnasium collapse kills nine, injures 10.
newsitem.headline: China gymnasium collapse kills nine, injures 10.

text.p: Nine people were killed and more than 10 injured when a north China gymnasium collapsed as workers were trying to demolish it, state radio and local reporters said on Tuesday.
The accident occurred in Yinchuan, capital of the Ningxia region, on Monday as workers tore down an outdated gymnasium to make way for a new one, a reporter in Yinchuan said by telephone.
"The stadium probably dated to the 1960s," he said. "They were working on one part of it when another part suddenly fell in."
The collapse killed nine workers, state radio said in a brief report on Tuesday. The local reporter said more than 10 were hurt but he declined to give further details.
China has been plagued by a spate of building collapses in recent months.
About 20 people were killed and more than 40 injured when a worker's dormitory in southeastern Fujian province collapsed last month.
Beijing has linked some of the accidents to shoddy construction and corruption.
